compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for selecting a preferred store for the "Order Ahead" service. The screen lists participating locations where the service is available, including:

- Hawaii
- Northern California
- Southern California
- Chicago
- New York

At the bottom of the screen, there is a red button labeled "Find My Preferred Store" for users to proceed with selecting their preferred store. The top of the screen has a title "Select Preferred Store."

reason: using this button to search my own preferred store.
